_comment: One hero per player. The hero leads the garrison of the village it stands in: its skills and gear add to that village's research effects (same keys as research.json) for battles there, and for scouts and caravans sent from there. XP comes from enemies killed in battles the hero fights in; level L needs `levelXp.base` x `levelXp.growth`^(L-1) more XP to reach L+1 and gives one skill point. A beaten horde may drop gear (`dropChance`); losing a battle wounds the hero for `woundHours` game hours. `speed` is hexes per hour on plains. Each player picks a hero from `roster` before the run (a hero not yet picked by someone else in the group); its `effects` are its strengths (positive) and weaknesses (negative), and each of its `traits` adds its own effects. Hero-only keys: `heroSpeed` (travel), `heroXp` (XP gained), `woundTime` (time spent wounded).

battle_fury.name: Battle Fury
battle_fury.description: +4% attack for every troop per rank.

shield_bearer.name: Shield Bearer
shield_bearer.description: +4% defense for every troop per rank.

hold_fast.name: Hold Fast
hold_fast.description: +5% for defenders at home per rank.

pathfinder.name: Pathfinder
pathfinder.description: Scouts from the hero's village travel 10% faster per rank.

keen_eyes.name: Keen Eyes
keen_eyes.description: Scouts from the hero's village are 5 points likelier to return per rank.

quartermaster.name: Quartermaster
quartermaster.description: Caravans from the hero's village carry 10% more per rank.

bear_cloak.name: Bear-hide Cloak
bear_cloak.description: From a cave bear of the north.

mokosh_thread.name: Thread of Mokosh
mokosh_thread.description: The spinner hides what is yours.

grey_stallion.name: Grey Stallion
grey_stallion.description: A warhorse of the old princes.

dobrynya.name: Dobrynya
dobrynya.title: The serpent-slayer prince
dobrynya.story: A prince's son who struck down the Zmey at the Puchai river. Bold in the charge, and a retinue to keep fed.

traits.name: Rallying cry
traits.description: His name alone makes men fight harder at their own gates.

vasilisa.name: Vasilisa
vasilisa.title: The forest huntress
vasilisa.story: She reads the forest like a letter. Her bow never misses, but she is no shield-wall fighter.

traits.name: Tracker
traits.description: Moves fast and teaches the scouts to come back alive.

volkh.name: Volkh
volkh.title: The wise volkhv
volkh.story: A priest of the old gods who knows herbs, stars and secrets. Wisdom over the sword.

traits.name: Healing rites
traits.description: Rises from wounds in half the time, and learns from every fight.

sadko.name: Sadko
sadko.title: The merchant rider
sadko.story: A gusli player turned the richest trader of Novgorod. Gold opens more gates than steel.

traits.name: Silver tongue
traits.description: Talks raiders out of a fifth of what they came for.

nastasya.name: Nastasya
nastasya.title: The shieldmaiden
nastasya.story: A polyanitsa of the steppe border who has never given ground. Slow to march, impossible to move.

traits.name: Unbreakable
traits.description: Her spearmen train faster and hold the walls longer.

ilya.name: Ilya
ilya.title: The old bogatyr
ilya.story: Thirty years he sat by the stove; then he rose stronger than any man. Strong in all things, slow to learn new ones.

traits.name: Strength of the earth
traits.description: Mother Earth hides him: he is wounded for less time.
